item.title: Students rally against tobacco use at West Virginia Capitol
item.description: House Bill 5108 has been filed and referred to the committee. The next step will be a committee hearing as lawmakers consider whether to move the bill forward.

item.title: Clarksburg woman pleads guilty to meth charges

item.title: West Virginia Women Work receives $300,000 grant from Lowe's Foundation to extend services
item.description: West Virginia Women Work is also still accepting applications for its Morgantown Step Up for Women Construction Pre-apprenticeship class, which begins on March 2.

item.title: West Virginia given more authority to regulate coal on federal land
item.description: West Virginia now has more authority to regulate coal mining and reclamation of federal lands in the Mountain State.

item.title: Local churches hold services for Ash Wednesday
item.description: 12 News went to All Saints Catholic Church in Bridgeport to learn more about the days leading up to Easter. Attending members of Wednesday's noon service experienced a time of worship and message before rising to their feet to receive ashes in the shape of a cross on their foreheads.

item.title: Restaurant Road Trip: The Good News Café
item.description: In June of 2025, The Good News Café opened its doors to the Elkins community, inviting people in to enjoy fast, delicious coffee.

item.title: Vehicle crashes into White Hall Panera, driver taken to hospital
item.description: Information is limited, but the Marion County 911 Communication Center confirmed that the incident took place at 6:52 a.m. The driver was sent to the Mon Health Neighborhood Hospital in White Hall, and there is currently no information on the extent of their injuries or what caused them to crash.

item.title: Randolph County Sheriff's Office searching for victims shot with BB gun
item.description: According to a press release from the sheriff's office, deputies received reports of a vehicle driving around the Elkins area and shooting at people with a BB gun. These reports were received on Feb. 7 and Feb. 8.
